subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

He was not __able to adopt himself to__ the new environment of the hostel.
solution:
The correct answer is option 4), i.e., 'able to adapt himself to.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in Part (able to adopt himself to) of the sentence.
 
• As per instructions, the remaining portion of the sentence is correct.
 
• **"Adopt"** means to take something as one's own, and it doesn't make sense to use it in this context.
 
• Instead, the correct word to use is **"adapt,"** which means** to adjust to new conditions**. Therefore, the correct phrase is **"able to adapt himself to the new environment of the hostel."**
 
• **Option 1, "Able to adept himself to"** is not correct because** "adept"** means skilled or proficient, and it doesn't fit the context of the sentence.
 
• Therefore, in the erroneous part, the use of 'adopt' in the sentence should be replaced with 'adapt' to make it meaningfully correct.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 4.

 

Correct sentence:__ *He was not **__able to adapt himself __****__to__** the new environment of the hostel.*
